candidates.name: OGC GeoTIFF Standard
verified_facts: OGC GeoTIFF defines requirements and encoding rules for georeferenced or geocoded imagery using TIFF.
GeoTIFF carries geographic metadata needed to describe and use geographic image data.
semantic_limits: A valid GeoTIFF encoding establishes georeferencing structure, not vertical accuracy, survey date, surface semantics or parcel provenance.

candidates.name: OGC Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF Standard
verified_facts: COG organizes TIFF/GeoTIFF data for efficient partial access using tiles, reduced-resolution subfiles and HTTP range requests.
The standard optimizes visualization and processing without requiring the whole file to be downloaded.
semantic_limits: Cloud optimization changes access/storage organization, not the underlying raster's measurement accuracy or evidential quality.
